blind.description: A stylized low wooden shelving rack/bookcase containing four tiers of ceramic pottery, including terracotta pots, jugs with handles, two-tone jars, and bowls. The shelf is crafted from warm medium-brown wood with corner posts and a panelled back. The pottery pieces feature hand-painted textures in terracotta orange-red, cream beige, and muted greyish-blue. Geometry is clean and solid, standing stably on four corner feet with no floating artifacts, broken shards, or unpainted surfaces.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top surface displaying four vessels in a row: a dual-handled terracotta pot, a round cream-and-terracotta jar, a grey-blue pitcher with a handle, and a wide terracotta bowl.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 60% of the figure's height (around 3.5 ft tall) and roughly 3.5 ft wide.
